name: eca-black-friday-blueprint
description: Ecommerce Academy Black Friday Blueprint — everything you need to plan and run BFCM. Decide a data-backed offer from last year's numbers, lock the phase calendar, then build the full email content calendar and copy off the back of it. Two skills that share one set of campaign files, so the offer, the dates and every send live in the same runsheet and dashboard.  What's new (v1.9.1): Added in Email Skill
